title: ObjectUserBody without massMatrixUserFunction for static problems
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG7.15.7: a user finite element may be used for a static problem only, so Assemble no longer requires the massMatrixUserFunction; the mass matrix raises when a solver or an output needs it.
releaseNotes: ObjectUserBody no longer requires a massMatrixUserFunction at Assemble, so a user finite element can be used for a static problem; without it, a dynamic solver or the kinetic energy raises a clear error.
